subject: Startups
title: Netflix's Culture Deck
description: Learn Netflix's Culture Deck in one minute.

hook.text: In 2009, Netflix published a 127-slide culture deck.

buildup.text: The deck promoted 'freedom and responsibility': hire adults, trust them, and remove processes that assume incompetence.

discovery.text: Key principle: 'adequate performance gets a generous severance.' Netflix wanted superstars, not warm bodies.

climax.text: The deck changed how Silicon Valley thinks about culture. Love it or hate it, it proved culture can be a strategy.

punchline.text: Netflix treated culture as a product. The deck was its spec.

quiz.question: What was Netflix's culture deck's core principle?
